body:
## Summary

`AnalyticPTDHestonEngine` is not defined at zero time to maturity. With the expiry
date equal to the term structures' reference date and
`Settings::includeReferenceDateEvents()` enabled (so the instrument is not marked
expired), the engine runs its piecewise-terminal-distribution expansion with a zero
time argument and returns an arbitrary value instead of the option's payoff.

Reproduced on current master: spot 100, strike 90, expiry on the reference date
returns 9.7647 under the Gatheral log formula with a 5-point Gauss-Laguerre
integration, and throws `stdDev (-nan) must be non-negative` under
Andersen-Piterbarg with Gauss-Lobatto. The correct value at zero time to maturity
is the undiscounted payoff, 10.

## Fix

Return the payoff directly when the computed time to maturity is exactly zero,
before any grid or characteristic-function machinery runs:

```cpp
if (term == 0.0) {
    results_.value = (*payoff)(spotPrice);
    return;
}
```

This is the same convention `blackFormula` already applies at zero standard
deviation: return the deterministic limit rather than evaluate a degenerate
formula. No other code path changes; positive maturities are untouched.

## Testing

| test | state | checks |
|---|---|---|
| `testPiecewiseTimeDependentZeroMaturity` (new) | expiry on reference date, `includeReferenceDateEvents` on, spot 100 / strike 90 | both Gatheral/Gauss-Laguerre and Andersen-Piterbarg/Gauss-Lobatto return exactly 10.0; the settings flag is RAII-restored |

Pre-fix the test fails with 9.7647 (Laguerre) and a NaN stdDev exception
(Lobatto); post-fix it passes. The full `HestonModelTests` suite and the complete
test suite (1710 cases) pass with the fix applied.

A Lean formalization of the zero-maturity collapse (the transform profile degenerates to the point-mass moment-generating function; the European price collapses to the undiscounted payoff) is submitted alongside this fix at formal-applied-math/formal-mathfin.

Prepared with AI assistance (ZCode/GLM-5.3-flash).

review_comments.body: we should also set `evaluations_` to 0 before returning
Done — 576ab4c69 sets `evaluations_ = 0` before the early return, so `numberOfEvaluations()` reports 0 after a degenerate calculation instead of a stale count from a previous one.

title: Return the payoff at zero maturity in `AnalyticPTDHestonEngine`
